subject: sg
title: SG.------FUND.DYM.
description: Diagram in WAC-8, paired with v1-p210-1. (C)SI (source initiation, the (c) prefix marking the conceptual reading) is crossed with FUND-DYN (fundamental dynamics): the question is what source initiation as a concept means in relation to a culture's fundamental dynamics — a structural claim about how foundational dynamics produce extension routes (Berg/Schoenberg/Webern as source-initiation extensions of the same European fundamental). SI outputs to FUND-DYN → POL-P (political policies), and to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) → INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) → TM (terminology of a definition). A separate chain runs TR-DEF (trans-definition) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and PHY-U-P → POL-DYM (political dynamics). VT-PLT (vibrational platform) → PHY-U-C (physical universe context). Structural argument: source initiation, conceptually understood, fans into two principal outputs — fundamental dynamics → political policies, and projectional dynamics → individual tendencies → terminology. The trans-definition / physical-universe-particular sub-chain is a parallel constituting layer that produces social reality dynamics and political dynamics independently. The diagram thus diagrams the *separateness* of source-initiation extension from the social-political real: these are parallel constituting tracks meeting only via shared conceptual subject.
